markdownEnumDescriptions:
### OpenAI
使用gpt-4、gpt-3.5-turbo或任何其他OpenAI模型。请查看[这里](https://openai.com/product#made-for-developers)获取API密钥。

> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/openai)

### 免费试用
新用户可以通过代理服务器免费试用iCoding，安全地使用我们的API密钥调用OpenAI。如果你已经准备好使用自己的API密钥或已使用完所有250次免费使用次数，你可以在config.json中输入你的API密钥`apiKey=""`或选择其他模型提供商。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/freetrial)

### Anthropic
要开始使用Anthropic模型，你需要先在[这里](https://claude.ai/login)注册开放测试版以获取API密钥。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/anthropicllm)

### Cohere
要使用Cohere，请访问[Cohere仪表板](https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys)创建API密钥。

> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/cohere)

### Bedrock
要开始使用Bedrock，你需要在AWS上注册[这里](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/claude/)

### Together
Together是一个托管服务，提供非常快速的开源语言模型流传输。要开始使用Together：
1. 从[这里](https://together.ai)获取API密钥
2. 粘贴下面
3. 选择一个模型预设
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/togetherllm)

### Ollama
要开始使用Ollama，请按照以下步骤操作：
1. 从[ollama.ai](https://ollama.ai/)下载并打开应用程序
2. 打开终端并运行`ollama run <MODEL_NAME>`。示例模型名称为`codellama:7b-instruct`或`llama2:7b-text`。你可以在[这里](https://ollama.ai/library)找到完整列表。
3. 确保步骤2中使用的模型名称与config.json中的模型名称相同（例如`model="codellama:7b-instruct"`）
4. 一旦模型下载完成，你可以通过iCoding开始提问。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/ollama)

### Huggingface TGI

> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/huggingfacetgi)

### Huggingface推理API

> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/huggingfaceinferenceapi)

### Llama.cpp
llama.cpp自带一个[内置服务器](https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/tree/master/examples/server#llamacppexampleserver)，可以从源码运行。要做到这一点：

1. 用`git clone https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp`克隆存储库。
2. `cd llama.cpp`
3. 运行`make`构建服务器。
4. 下载你想使用的模型并将其放在`llama.cpp/models`目录中（最好在[The Bloke on HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/TheBloke)找到模型）
5. 用以下命令运行llama.cpp服务器（替换为你下载的模型）：

```shell
.\server.exe -c 4096 --host 0.0.0.0 -t 16 --mlock -m models/codellama-7b-instruct.Q8_0.gguf
```

启动并运行后，你可以开始使用iCoding。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/llamacpp)

### Replicate
Replicate是一个托管服务，使运行ML模型变得简单。要开始使用Replicate：
1. 从[这里](https://replicate.com)获取API密钥
2. 粘贴下面
3. 选择一个模型预设
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/replicatellm)

### Gemini API
要开始使用Google Makersuite，请从[这里](https://makersuite.google.com)获取API密钥并粘贴在下面。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/geminiapi)

### LMStudio
LMStudio提供了一个专业且设计精良的GUI，用于探索、配置和服务LLM。它适用于Mac和Windows。要开始使用：
1. 从[lmstudio.ai](https://lmstudio.ai/)下载并打开应用程序
2. 从LMStudio主页搜索并下载所需模型。
3. 在左侧栏单击'<->'图标以打开本地推理服务器并按‘启动服务器’。
4. 一旦你的模型加载完成并服务器启动，你就可以开始使用iCoding。
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/lmstudio)

### Llamafile
要开始使用llamafiles，请在他们的[GitHub仓库](https://github.com/Mozilla-Ocho/llamafile#binary-instructions)中找到并下载二进制文件。然后用以下命令运行它：

```shell
chmod +x ./llamafile
./llamafile
```
> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/llamafile)

### Mistral API

要访问Mistral API，请从[Mistral平台](https://docs.mistral.ai/)获取API密钥。

### DeepInfra

> [参考](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/reference/Model%20Providers/deepinfra)

### iCoding Proxy

Continue Enterprise用户可以使用iCoding Proxy作为模型的单一访问点。

### Cloudflare Workers AI

[参考](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/)

useReranking.description: Whether to use re-ranking, which will allow initial selection of nRetrieve results, then will use an LLM to select the top nFinal results. Disabling re-ranking will give faster, but less accurate, results.

allowAnonymousTelemetry.title: Allow Anonymous Telemetry
allowAnonymousTelemetry.markdownDescription: If this field is set to True, we will collect anonymous telemetry as described in the documentation page on telemetry. If set to `false`, we will not collect any data. Learn more in [the docs](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/telemetry).

models.title: Models
models.markdownDescription: Learn about setting up models in [the documentation](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/model-setup/overview).

systemMessage.title: System Message
systemMessage.description: A system message that will always be followed by the LLM

completionOptions.title: Completion Options
completionOptions.description: Default options for completion. These will be overriden by any options set for a specific model.

requestOptions.title: Request Options
requestOptions.description: Default request options for all fetch requests from models and context providers. These will be overriden by any model-specific request options.

slashCommands.title: Slash Commands
slashCommands.markdownDescription: An array of slash commands that let you take custom actions from the sidebar. Learn more in the [documentation](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/customization/slash-commands).

customCommands.title: Custom Commands
customCommands.markdownDescription: An array of custom commands that allow you to reuse prompts. Each has name, description, and prompt properties. When you enter /<name> in the text input, it will act as a shortcut to the prompt. Learn more in the [documentation](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/customization/slash-commands#custom-commands-use-natural-language).

default.name: test
default.prompt:
{{{ input }}}

Write a comprehensive set of unit tests for the selected code. It should setup, run tests that check for correctness including important edge cases, and teardown. Ensure that the tests are complete and sophisticated. Give the tests just as chat output, don't edit any file.
default.description: This is an example custom command. Open config.json to edit it and create more

contextProviders.title: Context Providers
contextProviders.markdownDescription: A list of ContextProvider objects that can be used to provide context to the LLM by typing '@'. Read more about ContextProviders in [the documentation](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/customization/context-providers).

userToken.title: User Token
userToken.description: An optional token to identify the user.

dataServerUrl.title: Data Server Url
dataServerUrl.description: The URL of the server where development data is sent. No data is sent unless a valid user token is provided.

disableSummaries.title: Disable Summaries
disableSummaries.markdownDescription: If set to `true`, iCoding will not generate summaries for each Step. This can be useful if you want to save on compute.

disableIndexing.title: Disable Indexing
disableIndexing.markdownDescription: If set to `true`, iCoding will not index the codebase. This is mainly used for debugging purposes.

disableSessionTitles.title: Disable Session Titles
disableSessionTitles.markdownDescription: If set to `true`, iCoding will not make extra requests to the LLM to generate a summary title of each session.

embeddingsProvider.title: Embeddings Provider
embeddingsProvider.markdownDescription: The method that will be used to generate codebase embeddings. The default is transformers.js, which will run locally in the browser. Learn about the other options [here](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/walkthroughs/codebase-embeddings#embeddings-providers).

requestOptions.title: Request Options
requestOptions.description: Request options to be used in any fetch requests made by the embeddings provider

reranker.title: Reranker
reranker.markdownDescription: The reranker is responsible for selecting the final results when retrieving snippets from your codebase.

tabAutocompleteModel.title: Tab Autocomplete Model
tabAutocompleteModel.markdownDescription:
The model used for tab autocompletion. If undefined, iCoding will default to using starcoder2:3b on a local Ollama instance.

*IMPORTANT*:

If you use a custom model, ensure that it is one trained for fill-in-the-middle completions. An instruct model is typically not well-suited to autocomplete and you may receive unsatisfactory completions.

tabAutocompleteOptions.title: TabAutocompleteOptions
tabAutocompleteOptions.markdownDescription: These options let you customize your tab-autocomplete experience. Read about all options in [the docs](https://ic0ding.netlify.app/walkthroughs/tab-autocomplete#configuration-options).

disable.description: Disable tab autocomplete. This can also be done from the IDE settings.

useCopyBuffer.description: Determines whether the copy buffer will be considered when contructing the prompt.

useSuffix.description: Determines whether to use the file suffix in the prompt.

maxPromptTokens.description: The maximum number of prompt tokens to use. A smaller number will yield faster completions, but less context.

debounceDelay.description: The delay in milliseconds before triggering autocomplete after a keystroke.

maxSuffixPercentage.description: The maximum percentage of the prompt that can be dedicated to the suffix.

prefixPercentage.description: The percentage of the input that should be dedicated to the prefix.

template.description: An optional template string to be used for autocomplete. It will be rendered with the Mustache templating language, and is passed the 'prefix' and 'suffix' variables.

multilineCompletions.description: If set to true, iCoding will only complete a single line at a time.

onlyMyCode.description: If set to true, iCoding will not include any snippets from go to definition unless they are within your repository

useOtherFiles.description: Defaults to true. If set to false, iCoding will not attempt to include snippets from other files.

disableInFiles.description: A list of files / glob patterns in which to disable tab autocomplete. For example, *.csv if you'd like to disable autocomplete in .csv files.

codeBlockToolbarPosition.description: Whether to show the copy and apply code buttons at the top or bottom of code blocks in the sidebar.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Experimental properties are subject to change.

comment.default: Write comments for this code. Do not change anything about the code itself.

docstring.default: Write a docstring for this code. Do not change anything about the code itself.

fixGrammar.default: If there are any grammar or spelling mistakes in this writing, fix them. Do not make other large changes to the writing.

mergeBehavior.title: Merge behavior
mergeBehavior.markdownDescription: If set to 'merge', .continuerc.json will be applied on top of config.json (arrays and objects are merged). If set to 'overwrite', then every top-level property of .continuerc.json will overwrite that property from config.json.
